notablePrerequisites:
You control another creature that can attack this turn.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control
description:
Cast Sozin's Comet either from your hand by paying {3}{R}{R} or from exile for its foretell cost by paying {2}{R}, causing each creature you control to gain firebending 5 until end of turn.
Declare Hellkite Charger and at least one other creature as attackers, triggering each creature's firebending ability and Hellkite Charger.
Resolve each firebending trigger, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} for each attacking creature.
Resolve the Hellkite Charger trigger, causing you to pay {5}{R}{R} to untap all attacking creatures and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 2 each combat phase.

uses.name: Sozin's Comet
uses.cardState: was foretold on a previous turn
